_note: Links to the official AAIB report pages and PDFs, plus the short quotes the task notes rely on. The full report texts are not included in this repository (AAIB reports are published under the UK Open Government Licence v3.0; quotes remain under the publishers' terms). Quotes were copied from the AAIB PDFs on 1 Nov 2026 and re-checked against the official PDFs on 2 Nov 2026 with `python3 verify_sources.py --fetch`. Whitespace, hyphen and quote-mark variants are normalised in the check. The AAIB typo 'compete' (for 'complete') in the G-CIVX quote is kept as published.

quotes: did not have time to compete the function checks, and the task cards were left uncertified.
